images.caption: Figure 1:Illustration of video captioning with executable code.The reference video shows a flight seat-selection interface. (a) and (b) present natural language and code captions of the same segment, respectively. The code caption encodes spatial structure, temporal dynamics, and visual state changes through executable rules and functions.

Figure 2:The data construction pipeline of CodeCap-Bench.The pipeline comprises three stages: multi-source video collection, content filtering for structured 2D videos, and fine-grained annotation with human review, covering static and dynamic focal points and object-level spatio-temporal information.
